watches.name: Prototype - Field v3 - Polar Full-Lume (Automatic)
watches.description: Our Field v3 reinterprets the A-11, the field watch often called “ the watch that won the war ”. The dial is off-white/greenish and fully glows in the dark, with large numerals and pencil-shaped hands. watches.name: Standard Issue - Typhoon (Automatic)
watches.description: The Redwood Typhoon draws its inspiration from the rugged, no-nonsense watches of the Vietnam War era—built for the unforgiving demands of covert warfare. With its stealthy black dial, bold luminous markers, and resilient waterproof case, the Typhoon is a reimagined classic, upgraded with a modern movement and enhanced durability. While most of us won’t be crossing enemy lines, there’s something powerful about wearing a timepiece rooted in history, ready to handle whatever challenge comes its way. watches.name: Standard Issue - Kilroy GMT (Automatic)
watches.description: The Kilroy GMT draws inspiration from battle-hardened designs, influenced by the evolving specs of MIL-W-3818 and 46374, and gained further fame when Steve McQueen sported its civilian counterpart in Bullitt. Reimagined with modern proportions and a dual-time-zone automatic movement, the Kilroy GMT is built to tackle anything that comes its way. While most of us won’t be jumping out of planes into dense jungles, there’s something undeniably impressive about strapping on a watch with such a storied past—one that stands ready to live up to its legacy. watches.name: Vulcan - Stealth (Quad-Pulse)
watches.description: In 1948, the British Ministry of Defence introduced the Mk 11, a highly precise and dependable timepiece suitable for military aircraft navigation. Built to strict 6B/346 specifications, it became the gold standard for pilot watches, renowned for its water-resistant case, hacking seconds, and legibility that left nothing to chance. To aircrew aboard Avro high-altitude strategic bombers, it was more than a tool; it was “the crew member made of metal.” The Redwood Vulcan Stealth carries that spirit forward. Drawing from the legendary RAF design, it features the same clean symmetry, high-accuracy and no-nonsense utility.
